scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,blue "npm run dev -w @azhan-crm/api" "npm run dev -w @azhan-crm/web"

scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @azhan-crm/contracts && npm run build -w @azhan-crm/database && npm run typecheck -w @azhan-crm/api && npm run typecheck -w @azhan-crm/web
scripts.test:integration: npm run build -w @azhan-crm/contracts && npm run build -w @azhan-crm/database && npm run test:integration -w @azhan-crm/database && npm run test:integration -w @azhan-crm/api
